description: Scenario tests for hashtag-strategy. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-discoverability
evals.input: What hashtags should I use for my SaaS Reel about deleting a feature?
expect: reads brand-profile and audience first
sets the keyword/social-SEO layer first (caption + on-screen text + spoken audio) as the primary discovery lever
provides a tight, relevant hashtag set (not a 30-tag block), niche/mid-tier over generic
respects the platform's tag count/cap and recommends caption placement
suggests a branded tag where relevant and routes publishing to scheduling-and-queue
sets honest expectations that hashtags categorize/aid search, not drive reach

evals.name: viral-30-pushback
evals.input: Give me 30 hashtags so this goes viral.
expect: pushes back that 30 hashtags do not drive reach and that more tags is not more reach (2026 reality)
notes Instagram enforces a 5-hashtag cap, so 30 would be blocked/trimmed there anyway
redirects to the real levers: keywords/SEO, engagement, and the content/hook itself
delivers a tight relevant set instead of 30

evals.name: keywords-over-hashtags
evals.input: How do I get found in search on TikTok and Instagram?
expect: prioritizes keyword/social-SEO: the primary keyword in caption (front), on-screen text, and spoken audio
treats hashtags as supporting categorization signals, not the main lever
explains both platforms now function as search engines that index captions/audio/on-screen text

evals.name: instagram-5-cap
evals.input: Give me 12 Instagram hashtags for this post.
expect: states Instagram enforces a cap of 5 hashtags (rolled out Dec 2025) and won't allow 12
delivers ~3-5 precise, relevant tags instead
treats the number as current and flags to re-verify

evals.name: relevance-over-volume-no-generic
expect: declines generic mega-tags (#viral, #fyp, #explore, #instagood) as buried/useless
recommends niche/mid-tier relevant tags (roughly 10K-500K posts) instead
explains #fyp does not get content onto the For You Page

evals.name: platform-specific-not-one-block
evals.input: Same hashtags for LinkedIn, X, and TikTok, right?
expect: gives different approaches per platform, not one block: X ~0-2 (deprioritized), LinkedIn ~3-5 specific, TikTok ~3-5 treated as keywords
explains hashtags do different jobs on each platform
ties choices to where the audience actually is

evals.name: branded-campaign-hashtag
evals.input: We're launching a campaign and want people to share posts.
expect: designs a unique branded/campaign hashtag for UGC aggregation and tracking
checks the tag isn't already in use/conflicting and keeps it short/memorable
explains branded/campaign tags are a durable real use (community + tracking), distinct from discovery tags

evals.name: rotate-not-copy-paste
evals.input: Can I just paste the same hashtag block on every post?
expect: advises rotating 2-4 sets matched to content/pillar rather than one identical block
notes copy-pasting an identical block can read as spammy/low-effort and isn't ideal
accurately frames the shadowban claim as unconfirmed by Instagram while still recommending relevance/rotation

evals.name: no-analytics-claims
evals.input: Which hashtags perform best for us?
expect: does not claim WoopSocial provides hashtag analytics or performance data
points to native platform insights the user pulls (e.g., reach-from-hashtags) or qualitative review
frames hashtag testing as something to observe, not data it can supply
